allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange that, the Board of Directors of the Company vide circular resolution passed today i.e., November 05, 2026 has approved the allotment of 28,071,690 (Twenty-Eight Million Seventy-One Thousand Six Hundred Ninety) Warrants convertible into Equity Shares

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee ('NRC') of the Board of Directors of Aequs Limited ('Company') at its meeting held on October 26, 2026 has approved the grant of 2,00,000 (Two Lakh) Employee Stock Options ( Stock Options ) under the Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 25, 2026, titled "Aequs Board Approves INR 650 Crore Equity Infusion through Warrants by Promoter Group; 50 per cent Payable Upfront".

allot.subject: Preferential issue
allot.text: The Board of Directors of Aequs Limited, at their meeting held today i.e. Friday, September 25, 2026, inter alia, approved the preferential issue of warrants convertible into equity shares of the Company.

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee ( NRC ) of the Board of Directors of Aequs Limited ( Company ) at its meeting held on August 29, 2026, has approved to grant 350,000 Employee Stock Options ( Stock Options ) under Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025 ( ESOP 2025 ) on August 31, 2026.

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Board of Directors of the Company have approved Aequs Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2026 and Amendment to the Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange about the grant of Employee Stock Options to an eligible employee under Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Clarification in respect of Exercise Price and Vesting Criteria for all the grants under Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025 ( ESOP 2025 )
